coverage.setup_command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build meson libgmp-dev libmpfr-dev pkg-config && ./configure.py --prefix="$(pwd)/build/install" --testing --no-unit-testing
coverage.list_tests_command: jq -r '.[] | .cmd[] | select(contains("/test/regress/") and endswith(".smt2"))' bitwuzla/build/meson-info/intro-tests.json | sed 's#.*/test/regress/##' | sort -u
coverage.run_test_command: TEST_CMD=$(jq -r --arg t "test/regress/{test}" '[.[] | select(any(.cmd[]; endswith($t)))][0].cmd | @sh' bitwuzla/build/meson-info/intro-tests.json); eval timeout "${TEST_TIMEOUT:-120}" $TEST_CMD
